notes.defaultFovLongDeg: Field of view across the long side of the camera video. 70 is what Ben set on his iPhone on 2026-10-12, by eye: the Sun ring stayed on the Sun near the screen edge (65 put the ring about 20 percent too far from the centre). One phone, one test. Other phones can differ; the user can change it in Settings.
notes.magneticDeclinationDeg: WMM-2025 (NOAA/BGS World Magnetic Model, coefficients dated 2024-11-13) at 32.718 N, 79.9537 W, sea level, epoch 2026.79: -8.28 degrees; the high-resolution model gives -8.21. Computed 2026-10-15 with pygeomag 1.1.0 (WMM_2025.COF); see reference/source-audit.md. Was -8 (unverified) before 2026-10-15. Added to the phone's magnetic compass heading to get a true heading (negative is west). WMM-2025 gives -8.33 for 2027.79 (about 0.05 degree a year). Sun calibration on the page measures and stores the total compass error, so a small error here is corrected there.
